objective: Determine, without changing the model or store, whether the current repository contains observed organization/incident evidence that could support any later OPT-014 prior-predictive interpretation, held-out validation, backtesting, hierarchical-prior estimation, remediation-effect analysis, or portfolio modeling.
audit_unit: Aggregate schema and row-count evidence. No repository, organization, incident, finding, assessment, label, scenario, or simulation identity is emitted.
inventory_dimensions: Presence and aggregate row counts of observed organization-year, incident-count, realized-loss, observation-window, intervention, portfolio-membership, dependency, objective, and constraint records.
Aggregate counts of current risk scenarios and simulation runs by methodology version, classified as model-generated outputs rather than observed outcomes.
Aggregate counts of repositories, findings, assessments, and labels, classified as security-finding evidence rather than organization/incident outcome evidence.
Completeness of configured prior population, effective-date, data-vintage, aleatory-representation, and epistemic-status metadata.
Whether organization revenue/population applicability is configured, unknown, or outside the cited frequency population.
Availability of distinct organization and time units sufficient to define a future organization-held-out or chronological split, without selecting a split or judging statistical adequacy.
Availability of predefined cohort dimensions for a future hierarchical model, without inferring cohorts from outcomes.
Availability of time-stamped interventions and comparable pre/post or control observation windows for future remediation-effect work.
Availability of multiple portfolio units plus explicit dependency evidence, decision objective, and constraints for future portfolio modeling.

evidence_classification.observed_outcome_candidate: A directly observed, provenance-bearing organization-period record with an explicit observation window and incident count, optionally with realized loss and censoring metadata.
evidence_classification.model_generated_ineligible: A risk scenario, Monte Carlo draw, simulation summary, tornado result, or other output generated from the model; it cannot validate the model that generated it.
evidence_classification.finding_evidence_ineligible: A repository finding, triage score, assessment, label, severity, EPSS, KEV, or deal-risk component; it is not an organization-period incident or realized loss outcome.
evidence_classification.prior_input_ineligible_as_outcome: A published prior or the observations used to derive it; it cannot serve as an independent held-out outcome for that same prior.

capacity_classification.descriptive_prior_predictive_plumbing: Structurally possible when valid configured priors and a pure non-persisting simulator exist. This does not require observed outcomes and cannot clear the predictive-validation gate.
capacity_classification.held_out_or_backtest_candidate: Structurally possible only if independent observed organization-period outcomes and disjoint organization or time units exist. A positive structural count does not establish adequate sample size or authorize split selection.
capacity_classification.hierarchical_candidate: Structurally possible only if cohort dimensions were defined without outcome inspection and multiple independent organization-period observations exist across multiple cohorts. Statistical adequacy remains a later frozen decision.
capacity_classification.remediation_effect_candidate: Structurally possible only with time-stamped interventions plus comparable pre/post or contemporaneous-control outcome windows. Finding closure alone is not an outcome.
capacity_classification.portfolio_candidate: Structurally possible only with multiple portfolio units, explicit dependency evidence, a decision objective, and constraints. Summing repository or scenario simulations is ineligible.

decision_rule: The audit may classify each capacity as structurally present or absent and list aggregate missing dimensions. It may not declare the OPT-014 data gate cleared, select adequacy thresholds, choose a holdout, fit or compare a model, recommend a prior, or authorize portfolio decisions. Any positive capacity requires a separately frozen evaluation protocol; zero eligible observed outcomes supports a later choice among descriptive prior-predictive diagnostics, governed data acquisition, or bounded closure.
bounded_actions: Verify every bound input digest and current OPT-014 open/data-gated lifecycle state.
Open the production SQLite store in read-only mode and verify its digest remains byte-identical.
Inspect only table/column names, declared constraints, aggregate row counts, aggregate methodology counts, and aggregate null/completeness counts.
Read configured prior metadata and risk-quant population settings without changing them.
Persist one aggregate audit artifact and one descriptive result with no row identities or raw outcome values.
excluded: Network access, uploads, or external data acquisition
Raw row, identity, finding, assessment, label, source, incident, or loss rendering
Simulation, prior-predictive generation, model fitting, scoring, comparison, backtesting, or resampling
Holdout, cohort, threshold, or portfolio selection
New priors, hierarchical estimation, category allocation, remediation-effect estimation, or dependency assumptions
Tuning, recalibration, production-policy changes, OPT-014 promotion or closure
OPT-010 execution, branch integration, remote push, or deployment

hybrid_follow_up.if_observed_capacity_exists: Freeze eligibility thresholds, target population, leakage controls, and organization/time holdout rules before reading outcome values or fitting anything.
hybrid_follow_up.if_observed_capacity_is_absent: Choose separately between a descriptive prior-predictive coherence report, a governed independent-data acquisition plan, or bounded negative-feasibility closure.
